views.definition: CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ActiveProduct] AS SELECT p.[ProductID], p.[Sku], p.[Name], b.[Name] AS [BrandName] FROM [Product] p JOIN [Brand] b ON b.[BrandID] = p.[BrandID] WHERE p.[IsActive] = 1

query_patterns.query_text: SELECT TOP (10) [ArticleID], [Title] FROM [KnowledgeArticle] WHERE [Body] LIKE '%' + @Term + '%' ORDER BY [PublishedDate] DESC
SELECT t.[Priority], COUNT(*) AS [Open], AVG(DATEDIFF(hour, t.[OpenedDate], SYSUTCDATETIME())) AS [AgeHours] FROM [Ticket] t WHERE t.[Status] <> N'CLOSED' GROUP BY t.[Priority]

WITH [Thread] AS (SELECT [MessageID], [ReplyToMessageID], [Author], 0 AS [Depth] FROM [TicketMessage] WHERE [MessageID] = @MessageID UNION ALL SELECT m.[MessageID], m.[ReplyToMessageID], m.[Author], t.[Depth] + 1 FROM [TicketMessage] m JOIN [Thread] t ON m.[ReplyToMessageID] = t.[MessageID]) SELECT [MessageID], [Author], [Depth] FROM [Thread] OPTION (MAXRECURSION 16)
SELECT m.[Author], COUNT(*) AS [Replies] FROM [TicketMessage] m JOIN [Ticket] t ON t.[TicketID] = m.[TicketID] WHERE t.[Status] = N'OPEN' GROUP BY m.[Author]
SELECT [TicketID], [Subject], [Status], [OpenedDate] FROM [Ticket] WHERE [CustomerID] = @CustomerID ORDER BY [OpenedDate] DESC
SELECT t.[TicketID], t.[Subject], t.[Priority], t.[CustomerID] FROM [Ticket] t WHERE t.[Status] = @Status ORDER BY t.[Priority] DESC, t.[OpenedDate]
SELECT t.[TicketID], t.[Subject], m.[Author], m.[Body], m.[SentDate] FROM [Ticket] t JOIN [TicketMessage] m ON m.[TicketID] = t.[TicketID] WHERE t.[TicketID] = @TicketID
SELECT t.[TicketID], COUNT(m.[MessageID]) AS [Messages] FROM [Ticket] t JOIN [TicketMessage] m ON m.[TicketID] = t.[TicketID] WHERE t.[CustomerID] = @CustomerID GROUP BY t.[TicketID]
